_comment: Findings from analysing the mods' own packs (curator/analyze_pack.py; results in curator/raw/packs/<mod>.json). Field overrides like the other followup files; applied after the research pass because they rest on the files themselves.

relations.note: Soft requirement: without the mod, an NSFW skin is loaded by default; with the mod, 16 variants are selectable
Not needed: the pack already contains Beautiful Neferata's models and textures (22 identical files). Using both only adds a second copy.
Not needed: the pack brings its own versions of this mod's look. Loaded above Naughty Neferata, it would replace Neferata's default mesh definition and portraits and break the variants.

loadOrder.note: Only matters if the two Steam Neferata mods are kept installed: Naughty Neferata must win over both.

knownIssues: Self-contained: the two Steam Neferata mods the page names were merged into this pack and are not needed. If they stay active, load Naughty Neferata above them.
mods._fix: Pack analysis 2026-11-01: (X)_Naughty_Nef_XXX.pack, 174 files, no declared dependencies; all 138 model/material/texture references resolve to the pack itself (92) or the base game (38), none only to the Steam mods. 22 of 23 files shared with Beautiful Neferata are byte-identical; all 6 shared with 3809129102 differ (its vmp_neferata.variantmeshdefinition and portraits).

installNotes: The page says it probably needs Mixu's Unlocker, but the pack does not refer to it: it only uses base-game keys (Wood Elves building culture, the Carcassonne landmark slot).
knownIssues: Adds a Wood Elf landmark in the Carcassonne landmark slot; other mods that change that slot may clash.

openQuestions: Possible clash with Corrupted Landmarks or other landmark mods over the Carcassonne slot is unverified (those packs are not analysed yet).

mods._fix: Pack analysis 2026-11-01 (raw/packs/ll-25677.json): db + text only (16 tables, 4 .loc); all keys are base-game keys (wh_main_bas_brt, wh3_main_secondary_addon_landmark_carcassonne, wood_elves_city_oak_of_ages).

knownIssues: Replaces about 3,400 faction flag and banner images (ui/flags). It shares 631 of them with RS0371's Slaanesh's image and text and 6 with Corrupted Cathay (Miao) Flag: the mod loaded higher decides which image shows.

openQuestions: Overlap with Lewd Flags and Loading Screens (ll-41124) not checked yet.

mods._fix: Pack analysis 2026-11-01 (raw/packs/ll-49568.json): one pack TardBannerPackBetter-V1.00.pack, 3436 files, all under ui/flags; no dependencies.

packs.note: Two downloads with the same pack name: images only, or images and text. Install one of them.

knownIssues: Shares 631 flag images with TardBannerPackBetter (ll-49568); the mod loaded higher wins.
mods._fix: Pack analysis 2026-11-01 (raw/packs/ll-28211.json): both zips hold EFT.pack (1863 ui, 46 text, 2 db files).

knownIssues: The pack refers to 51 model and texture files that are neither in it nor in the base game; all of them are in (X)_Cathay_ALL_XXX.pack from the same author's Sexy Cathay Heroes collection (ll-49648). Without it, parts of the model may show missing textures (not checked in game).

openQuestions: Relationship to the Steam original 3574561438 (spin-off/rip): usable together or incompatible - not stated.
Whether the 51 references to the Sexy Cathay Heroes collection matter in game is unverified; the page calls the mod stand-alone.

mods._fix: Pack analysis 2026-11-01 (raw/packs/ll-52245.json): 199 references: 59 in the pack, 79 base game, 61 unresolved, 51 of them found only in ll-49648.
